title: Ridgeline Warranty Coverage Volume Rate on Prorated Sealed Unit Replacement
content:
Under Warranty Coverage, a prorated sealed glass replacement takes a volume rate by the number of units approved on the claim's decision:

| Units approved | Volume rate |
|---|---|
| 6 or more | 0.1 (six-unit volume rate, 10 percent) |
| 3 to 5 | 0.05 (three-unit volume rate, 5 percent) |
| fewer than 3 | none |

In clause form: six or more units approved take the six-unit volume rate; three to five units approved take the three-unit volume rate; fewer units take no volume rate.

## Boundary cases

| Units approved | Volume rate |
|---|---|
| 2 | none |
| 3 | 5 percent |
| 5 | 5 percent |
| 6 | 10 percent |
| 9 | 10 percent |

The count is the units on the decision that approved the claim with proration, as the warranty decision records show.
